java_server.json_null_body: Spring GraphQL: a body of `null` gives 500 (NullPointerException in the HTTP handler) instead of 400. Framework behaviour, not generated code.
java_server.ws_unknown_message_type: Spring GraphQL closes the socket with 1011 instead of the protocol's 4400 for an unknown message type.
java_server.ws_invalid_json: Spring GraphQL closes the socket with 1011 instead of 4400 for a text frame that is not JSON.
java_server.ws_subscribe_without_payload: Spring GraphQL closes the socket with 1011 instead of 4400 for a subscribe message without payload.
java_server.ws_unknown_variable_type: Spring GraphQL: a subscription whose variable cannot be coerced never answers (no error, no complete); the client waits forever.
